name: Seagate Technology
legalName: Seagate Technology Holdings public limited company
description: Seagate makes hard disk drives (HDDs) and some storage systems. Its customers are hyperscale cloud companies, enterprises and PC/device makers (80 percent of revenue is sold to OEMs, including cloud builders), plus distributors and retailers. Its portfolio is split into Data Center (high-capacity HDDs up to 44TB and storage systems up to 3.5PB, built on its Mozaic HAMR heat-assisted recording platform) and Edge IoT (1TB to 32TB drives), and revenue rose 34 percent in fiscal 2026 from more nearline exabytes shipped and pricing actions, lifting gross margin from 35 to 46 percent. It competes with Western Digital and Toshiba in HDDs and with NAND flash makers.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label as shown on Wikipedia's List of S&P 500 companies (columns GICS Sector and GICS Sub-Industry). That page does not show the industry group or industry, so those are null rather than filled from memory.

hq.note: Principal executive offices 121 Woodlands Avenue 5, Singapore 739009 (FY2026 10-K cover); the company is incorporated in Ireland. Wikipedia S&P list shows Dublin, Ireland (see conflicts).

employees.note: About 30,000 full-time employees worldwide, about 25,000 in Asia (FY2026 10-K)

businessLines.name: OEMs (including hyperscale cloud and enterprise)
businessLines.how: Drives sold per unit by capacity to a small number of very large buyers.
businessLines.description: High-capacity data center HDDs and systems sold to cloud service providers, hyperscalers, enterprise OEMs and device makers.

businessLines.description: HDDs and systems sold through distributors to resellers and integrators.

businessLines.description: Drives and storage products sold through retailers.
